scope: Case inventory and exact observed assertions, not whole-client or library compliance

domains.scope: UTF-8 byte counts, surrogate lengths, repeated-input cache and unsigned high/low word safe-integer guards; no complete binary reader/writer coverage
Tail-length removal, uniform padding vectors and two input guards; random padding, cryptographic operations and authentication remain uncovered
Media type literal/alias classification only; serialization, rendering, encryption and server acceptance remain uncovered
Star-index JSON and minimum tuple-length rejection only; valid indices, mutations, LTHash and MACs remain uncovered
AEA string-state predicate with its real archived enum only; attestations, ADV mapping, eligibility and live account state remain uncovered
The media-type classifier does not cover upload, download, decoding or rendering
